output.summary: A deciduous shrub native to the Americas east of the Rocky Mountains and south to Bolivia. It bears large clusters of white summer flowers and drooping clusters of dark purple-black fruit; only ripe berries cooked with their seeds removed are suitable for food.
output.edibilityNote: Only ripe berries should be cooked and have their seeds removed; traditional jams, jellies and syrups use cooked, strained fruit.
